```{r, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(zellkonverter)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(R.utils)
library(here)
```

###################
## Read in Data ##
###################

```{r}
data_dir <- here("scRNAseq_data", "zea_mays")
```

```{r}
files <- list.files(path = data_dir, pattern = "\\.h5ad\\.gz$", full.names = TRUE)
```

```{r}
read_h5ad_gz <- function(file){
  h5ad_file <- gunzip(file, overwrite = TRUE, remove = FALSE) # keep .gz
  sce <- readH5AD(h5ad_file)
  return(sce)
}
```

## convert to single cell experiments

```{r, message = FALSE}
sce_list <- lapply(files, read_h5ad_gz)
names(sce_list) <- sub("\\.h5ad\\.gz$", "", basename(files))
```
=> sce_list is now a list of single cell experiments


```{r}
sce_info <- lapply(sce_list, function(x){
  list(
    n_genes = nrow(x),
    n_cells = ncol(x),
    assays = names(assays(x)),
    colData_cols = colnames(colData(x))
  )
})

sce_info

```
